name: Sidonie of Saxony
contribution: A princess of the House of Wettin and by marriage Duchess of Brunswick-Lüneburg and Princess of Calenberg-Göttingen.
image_credit: Lucas Cranach the Elder · Public domain

checks.lead: Sidonie of Saxony (also: Sidonia; 8 March 1518, Meissen – 4 January 1575, Weißenfels) was a princess of the House of Wettin and by marriage Duchess of Brunswick-Lüneburg and Princess of Calenberg-Göttingen.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
